## Purpose and executable entry point
This is the Go implementation of GitHub CLI (`gh`): a standalone terminal client for GitHub.com, Enterprise Cloud, and Enterprise Server. The production executable starts at `cmd/gh/main.go`, builds the command graph through `pkg/cmd/root/root.go`, and is wired with shared dependencies by `pkg/cmd/factory/default.go`.

## Command graph and execution model
`pkg/cmd/root` registers top-level commands, aliases, help, extensions, and official-extension stubs. Feature areas are independently organized under `pkg/cmd/*`; command implementations parse arguments/flags, resolve repository and host context, invoke API/Git services, and render terminal output. Representative high-value domains are:
- Pull requests: `pkg/cmd/pr/pr.go`, `pkg/cmd/pr/create/create.go`, `pkg/cmd/pr/merge/merge.go`
- Issues: `pkg/cmd/issue/issue.go`, `pkg/cmd/issue/create/create.go`
- Repositories: `pkg/cmd/repo/repo.go`, `pkg/cmd/repo/clone/clone.go`
- Actions workflows/runs: `pkg/cmd/workflow/workflow.go`, `pkg/cmd/run/run.go`

## Shared command boundary
`pkg/cmdutil` supplies cross-cutting CLI behavior: factories, argument parsing, auth checks, JSON output flags, repository overrides, and telemetry hooks. `pkg/iostreams` is the terminal I/O boundary for stdout/stderr, color, progress, and platform-specific console behavior. Interactive workflows use `internal/prompter`, isolating prompts from command business logic and allowing noninteractive/test substitutions.

## GitHub API and repository resolution
The `api` package is the primary GitHub REST/GraphQL transport boundary: `api/client.go`, `api/http_client.go`, and query modules such as `api/queries_pr.go`. Commands generally depend on injected clients rather than directly on HTTP. Repository/host selection combines Git remote inspection and explicit arguments through `context/context.go`, `context/remote.go`, `internal/ghrepo/repo.go`, and `pkg/cmd/factory/remote_resolver.go`. This separates local repository identity from remote GitHub operations.

## Local Git and credential state
The CLI shells out to the installed Git executable via `git/client.go` and `git/command.go`; commands such as PR checkout/create and repo clone cross this boundary. Persistent host/account configuration is managed in `internal/config/config.go`, with migrations in `internal/config/migration/multi_account.go`. Authentication flows, token storage, browser interaction, and Git credential-helper setup are separated across `internal/authflow/flow.go`, `internal/keyring/keyring.go`, and `pkg/cmd/auth/shared/login_flow.go`.

## Extensibility and agent skills
Extensions are external executable commands discovered and managed by the CLI; the command-facing layer is `pkg/cmd/extension/extension.go`, while shared extension metadata/official-extension handling lives in `pkg/extensions/extension.go` and `pkg/extensions/official.go`. Agent skills form a separate lifecycle—source discovery, frontmatter parsing, install/update state, and registry interaction—under `internal/skills/discovery/discovery.go`, `internal/skills/installer/installer.go`, and `pkg/cmd/skills/skills.go`.

## Specialized remote services and supply-chain features
Codespaces commands use GitHub APIs plus gRPC/RPC and SSH/port-forwarding components (`internal/codespaces/codespaces.go`, `internal/codespaces/rpc/invoker.go`, `internal/codespaces/portforwarder/port_forwarder.go`). Attestation commands retrieve GitHub artifact attestations and verify Sigstore/TUF trust material (`pkg/cmd/attestation/attestation.go`, `pkg/cmd/attestation/verification/sigstore.go`, `pkg/cmd/attestation/verification/tuf.go`). Telemetry is asynchronous/best-effort and must not break commands (`internal/telemetry/telemetry.go`, `internal/gh/ghtelemetry/telemetry.go`).

## Runtime, delivery, and platform boundaries
The runtime is a compiled Go CLI distributed for macOS, Linux, and Windows. OS-specific behavior appears in files such as `internal/flock/flock_unix.go`, `internal/flock/flock_windows.go`, and `pkg/iostreams/console_windows.go`. Release packaging and automation are defined by `.goreleaser.yml`, `build/windows/gh.wixproj`, `build/macOS/distribution.xml`, and `.github/workflows/deployment.yml`.
